description: This Java interface defines configuration methods for persistence cleanup actions within the Eclipse Ditto project, including timeout durations, parallelism, credit decisions, and other related settings.

classes.name: PersistenceCleanupConfig
classes.description: Java interface for persistence cleanup configuration settings, extending BackgroundStreamingConfig, providing method signatures for retrieving various configuration parameters, and a nested enum for config key defaults.

methods.name: fromConfig
methods.description: Static method to create a PersistenceCleanupConfig instance from a given HOCON Config object.
